Althought I like that this is an evidence backed video that goes against AI doomerism, I think its valuable to point out everything that comes with adopting AI for productivity gains. The industrial revolution has to led to us having to deal with climate change. For allllll of those productivity gains it came at a incredibly significant cost that was not properly addressed. In order to effectively adopt AI to increase your efficiency, we must slow down to examine the costs of doing so. I won't even get into the implications of being boiled down to a few data points to train these models, but we should heavily consider those costs as well.
